title: Microsoft Entra ID (Microsoft Graph, app registration with read-only application permissions)

checks.title: Every enabled user has registered an MFA method
checks.scope: Registration only; whether MFA is required at sign-in is shown by entra.ca_mfa_all_users or entra.security_defaults.

checks.title: Every admin has a phishing-resistant method registered (FIDO2 or passkey, Windows Hello for Business, certificate)
checks.scope: Registered, not enforced: an authentication strength in Conditional Access is what makes admins use it.

checks.title: An enabled Conditional Access policy requires MFA or an authentication strength for all users and all apps
checks.scope: Excluded users, groups and roles are counted in the detail, not judged.

checks.title: An enabled Conditional Access policy blocks legacy authentication (Exchange ActiveSync and other clients) for all users
Security defaults are on, or off because Conditional Access requires MFA for everyone
checks.scope: Tenant-wide baseline; per-application exceptions are not visible here.

checks.title: At most --entra-max-global-admins principals hold Global Administrator
checks.scope: Active assignments of the Global Administrator role only; other privileged roles are not counted.

checks.title: Global Administrator is held through PIM eligibility, with at most --entra-max-permanent-admins permanent (break-glass) assignments
checks.scope: Needs Entra ID P2; Global Administrator only.

checks.title: Only admins and the Guest Inviter role may invite guests
checks.scope: The invitation setting; the guest count is reported in the detail, not judged.

checks.title: No enabled account has gone --entra-stale-days days without signing in
checks.scope: Interactive and non-interactive sign-ins; needs Entra ID P1. Service principals are not users and are not counted.

checks.title: The directory audit log is readable and not empty
checks.scope: Readability only; retention and forwarding to a SIEM are not visible.

checks.title: An enabled Conditional Access policy acts on sign-in or user risk
checks.scope: Needs Entra ID P2; skipped when the tenant has none.

checks.title: Every enabled member account has a strong method registered and is in scope of an MFA requirement
checks.scope: Per account, from the registration report (isMfaCapable: a strong method allowed by the authentication methods policy; SMS and voice count, as Microsoft counts them) and from coverage: security defaults, or an enabled Conditional Access policy for all apps without risk, location, platform or client-app conditions that makes MFA mandatory (mfa or an MFA authentication strength, no other control under OR), with included and excluded users, groups (transitive) and roles (active assignments) resolved to accounts. A policy whose exclusions cannot be resolved is not credited. Guests and disabled accounts are counted, not judged; --entra-mfa-exempt names break-glass accounts, listed by object id. Needs Entra ID P1 or P2; skipped without the report. Excluded applications and PIM-eligible role holders are not judged.
